body: Done I hope, thanks for the feedback. Wasn't clear on whether to add this to the 4.5 .expected file or not. I know this is late in the release cycle and don't expect it to land in 4.6, so please let me know if it should be removed and held back for a 4.6 .expected file whenever that is created, or if there are other changes I need to make.

> I know this is late in the release cycle and don't expect it to land in 4.6

Too late for big features, not for bug-fixes (even if minor internal API changes are needed). So it should be fine for 4.6.
At least with macOS VoiceOver, this change seems to entirely break all caret movement/text selection announcements, which were working, now nothing is announced at all, only newly entered text.
Tested your second diff under Orca and it works identically. Applied and amended--thanks for testing!
